==Description==
'''Retro Rocket Arena''' is a [[Maps|map]] that resembles the first version of [[Rocket Arena]]. It can be played in any of the survival modes.

==Design & Path==
'''Retro Rocket Arena''' is a brickbattle-styled map, with a blocky feel and square stud, which resemble an old Roblox-style game. There are nine blue pillars with green and yellow bridges connecting adjacent pillars. Billboards can also be found across the map. Debris from trowels and rocket launchers could be seen around the map.

The grey path starts at an green spawn. It takes a large circular route, crossing over the same point in the middle of the map twice. At the end of the path is a red spawn point.

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Easy|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*This map only contains nine pillars, all of which contain very limited space.
**Towers which take up larger amount of space, like the [[Turret]] or [[Gatling Gun]] are less ideal here.
**Towers with smaller placement footprints, like the [[Shotgunner]], excel here.
*While this map does have cliff space, it is only the small pillars next to the bridges. This means the cliff spots are spread apart, making providing buffs to your towers difficult.
*Towers with the ability to cover large areas of the map, like the [[Turret]] or [[Pursuit]] are recommended here.

==Trivia==
*This map is based on the original ''Rocket Arena'' game by Roblox.
